title: The Efficacy of Pain Management With Self-reporting Pain Monitoring System in Cancer Patient
brief_summary: To compare the pain scales between clinician evaluated and reported with wearable device by patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* over 20 year old
* cancer pain with visual analog scale or numeric rating scale score \>/- 4
* opioids candidates
* with informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* life expectancy within 3 months
